# PayStage

> Payment safety layer for agents. Small, focused MCP tools that compose into a payment
> safety layer. Three tools available now: payment preflight, auth watch, and HIP-3 trade
> preflight. A hosted pay-per-call HTTP API is live on Base mainnet and Base Sepolia.

Not financial advice. The trade preflight tool is a local policy gate only — it does not
place orders or recommend trades.

## Tools (available now)

- `evaluate_mcp_payment` — evaluate a proposed x402 payment against a local policy file
  before signing. Package: `@paystage/mcp` (0.2.0).
- `list_outstanding_auths` — list outstanding ERC-20, Permit2, and EIP-3009 authorizations.
  Package: `@paystage/auth-watch` (0.1.0).
- `evaluate_outstanding_auths` — flag outstanding authorizations that need attention.
  Package: `@paystage/auth-watch` (0.1.0).
- `evaluate_hip3_trade` — evaluate a proposed HIP-3 / trade.xyz order against a local
  `TradePolicy`; returns `allow` | `review` | `do_not_trade`. Package:
  `@paystage/trade-preflight` (0.1.2), also exposed via `@paystage/mcp` (0.2.0).

## Hosted pay-per-call HTTP API

- Base mainnet (live): https://api.paystage.xyz — `eip155:8453`, USDC, payTo treasury.
- Base Sepolia (live): https://sepolia.api.paystage.xyz — `eip155:84532`.
- Price: $0.002 USDC per call on both networks.

## Packages

- `@paystage/mcp` (0.2.0) — umbrella MCP server, 4 tools. `npx -y @paystage/mcp`
- `@paystage/auth-watch` (0.1.0) — outstanding-auth tools
- `@paystage/trade-preflight` (0.1.2) — HIP-3 / trade.xyz trade preflight.
  `npx -y @paystage/trade-preflight`

## Links

- Website: https://paystage.xyz
- GitHub: https://github.com/base-buzz/paystage
- HIP-3 context: https://docs.trade.xyz
